about_hero_sub: HerdFlow is the all-in-one digital marketplace for livestock trade, agricultural products, and logistics coordination across South Africa.
our_story_p1: HerdFlow was born from a simple observation: South African farmers needed a modern, trusted platform to buy and sell livestock and agricultural products. Traditional methods were inefficient, lacked transparency, and created unnecessary friction in agricultural trade.
our_story_p2: We set out to build a platform that puts farmers first—combining the convenience of ecommerce with the trust and relationships that agricultural communities depend on. Today, HerdFlow connects buyers, sellers, and logistics partners across all provinces, making agricultural trade faster, safer, and more profitable for everyone.
founded_caption: Founded with a mission to modernize agriculture
feature_marketplace_desc: Browse verified livestock listings from trusted farmers across South Africa. Every listing includes detailed breed information, health records, and seller verification.
feature_products_desc: Shop for farm equipment, feed, veterinary supplies, and more from verified sellers. Secure checkout with PayFast ensures safe transactions every time.
feature_logistics_desc: Connect with verified logistics partners for reliable livestock and product delivery across all provinces. Track your shipments in real-time.
why_verified_sellers_desc: Every seller goes through identity verification and farm documentation before approval.
why_secure_payments_desc: All transactions processed through PayFast for maximum security and buyer protection.
why_regional_coverage_desc: Active across all nine provinces with growing logistics partner network.
why_mobile_first_desc: Optimized for rural connectivity and field usage—works great even on slow networks.
geyer_p1: HerdFlow is developed and operated by Geyer Holdings, a family-owned agricultural investment company based in the North West Province of South Africa.
geyer_p2: With deep roots in South African farming communities and decades of experience in agricultural operations, Geyer Holdings understands the challenges facing farmers today. HerdFlow represents our commitment to leveraging technology to strengthen agricultural trade, improve market access, and support rural economic development.
our_mission_desc: Empower farmers with modern tools for transparent, efficient agricultural trade.
our_values_desc: Trust, transparency, and community-first approach in everything we do.
our_vision_desc: Become the leading agricultural marketplace across Southern Africa.
ready_to_start_sub: Join thousands of farmers, buyers, and logistics partners using HerdFlow to transform agricultural trade.
follow_us_sub: Follow us for the latest listings, auction dates and farming news
contact_hero_sub: We're here to help. Get in touch with our team.
get_in_touch_desc: Whether you're a buyer, seller, or logistics partner, our team is ready to assist you with any questions or concerns.
